about: The Journal of Comical Physics (AIP Perishing, Silverchair's platform): complete citation_* tags, one author; its citation_pdf_url (article-pdf) sends a fetch on to a signed address on another site (watermark.silverchair.com). Saved 2026-11-12.

chainFrom: The extension's log, 2026-11-12: the page's fetch of the PDF link fails ("NetworkError": sent on to another site), so the extension fetches it itself and gets Cloudflare's "Just a moment…" (403); a page load in a tab gets the PDF (saved so in Firefox).
